cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring me the birthday invitations. I'll decide how we correct this failure in address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You put our old address as the party venue on every card. Shouldn't you rewrite them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can start replacement cards while I examine why the archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the archive. There's nobody else to examine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I rule this a staffing failure across storage, checking and dispatch. You'll be the second checker. Put one corrected card in front of me; we'll repair the process before anyone writes a personal apology.

reason: Reread found replacement envelopes did not necessarily repair the invitation venue. Explicitly locate the wrong address in the party-venue line and replace cards, preserving the personal fault and systemic evasion.
